# Ser Üretim Plastik

Official website: https://ser-plastik.com
Location: Denizli, Türkiye
Contact e-mail: info@ser-plastik.com
Mobile / WhatsApp: +90 533 666 73 81
Factory / office phone: +90 258 371 30 50

## Company
Ser Üretim Plastik has 20 years of plastic packaging production experience.
The company combines modern production with a customer-focused service approach and serves domestic and international customers.
Each order is treated as part of a long-term business partnership.

## Products
- Courier bags
- Industrial packaging
- Plastic / nylon bags
- Garbage bags
- Transparent / cellophane packaging
- Under-aggregate polyethylene sheet
- Printed and unprinted bags
- Reinforced carrier bags
- Second-quality bags
- Recycled bags
- Custom plastic packaging solutions

## Custom production
Custom dimensions, printing and designs can be evaluated according to customer needs, product properties and application areas.

## Website functions
Visitors can:
- Review Ser Plastik product groups
- Request a quotation
- Contact the sales team through WhatsApp
- Use Mimi, Ser Plastik’s AI sales assistant, for product and quotation support
